title: Judicial Reference from Evangel Presbytery for Adjudication
summary: Evangel Presbytery asked the SJC to accept and adjudicate a judicial reference. The SJC did not accede to the request. The published report gives no reason for declining the reference and no judgment on the underlying matter.

sources.supported_claims: Identifies the judicial reference and records that the SJC did not accede to the request.

sources.locator: line 1552, SJC report at printed p. 93; line 11583, judicial-case index
sources.supported_claims: The full Minutes confirm the same final docket disposition and supply no explanatory opinion.

source_limits: Only a docket-level final notice is published. It does not identify the underlying controversy or explain why the SJC declined the reference.
evidence_notes: The source supports refusal to accept and act on the reference, not rejection of any underlying claim.
No later merits decision for this docket was located in the repository Minutes or case pages.

score_reasons.concrete_dispute: The source identifies the procedural request but not its underlying subject.
score_reasons.decision: Accurately states that the SJC did not accede.
score_reasons.decisive_reason: Correctly preserves that no reason was published.
score_reasons.distinctive_value: Distinguishes refusal of the reference from a merits ruling.
score_reasons.fidelity: Adds no unsupported facts or rationale.
score_reasons.economy: Appropriately short for a sparse notice.

verification_notes: Separate source-checking pass by the same reviewer compared the stub with the full Minutes report and index; both support only the refusal and no merits explanation.
repair_notes: The canonical title includes disposition and cross-reference text ('Not acceded to by the SJC, See 31-35, II, p. 93'). It should be cleaned to the source caption without changing the source-limited disposition.
